description: Save what this chat session found out into the project's memory (specs/CONTEXT.md and context/AREA.md) when the work happened outside a spec, then refresh GitRisk. Use when the user says "capture this", "save what we learned", "update the context from this chat", "remember this for the project", "/spec-capture", or at the end of an ad-hoc investigation or bug hunt done in plain chat. Only confirmed findings about the repos or packages configured in .spec-driven.yml are saved, and only after the user says yes. Does not commit (use spec-checkpoint) and does not create the context (use spec-setup).
